_comment: PostgreSQL overlay. Apply with --profile postgres. Arrays APPEND to the base config; EDIT the data bind 'source' to a host path (it must exist). See profiles/README.md.
_comment_shm: Postgres needs more shared memory than the OCI default 64MB; give /dev/shm a real size and raise it for many connections / large work_mem.
_comment_env: Set POSTGRES_PASSWORD (or POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD) in the container's registry 'env' - NOT here, this file is shared. TZ is a convenience.
